title: platform incident replay case v1
description: One file per incident in a repo's platform/incidents/ folder, named INC-YYYY-MM-DD-slug.json. An incident is something a person noticed before the system did. It is a replay case: the repo's detector (anomaly, learning or verification job) must flag it inside its window, and until it does the incident stays open on a roadmap item. Check: python3 platform/kit/incidents.py check

properties.id: INC-YYYY-MM-DD-slug, equal to the file name without .json
properties.signals: list of entity ids, files, jobs or pages where the evidence lives
properties.window: {start, end} ISO timestamps (Z); the detector must flag inside it
properties.should_flag: true for a case the detector must catch; false for a known-normal replay (a false-positive guard)
properties.detector: optional: which job flags it, and when
properties.seatbelt: required while detector_status is none or seatbelt_only: the guard shipped so it cannot recur meanwhile (a labelled stop-gap, not the fix)
properties.item: required unless detector_status is caught_in_time: the work item id (in this repo's list) the detector work is tracked on
